data.name: Anma
data.gender_notes: Anma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anma is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘an’ meaning grace or nourishment and ‘ma’ meaning mother. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. In Hindu mythology, Anma is also associated with the goddess Annapurna, who is the goddess of food and nourishment. The name Anma carries the meaning “Nourishment, Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anma usually hope their child will grow to embody nourishment, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with grace and nourishment, symbolizing the maternal love and care of the divine.
data.etymology: Anma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nourishment, Grace.”

data.cultural_impact: Anma is a Sanskrit name, deeply rooted in the rich Hindu culture. In this culture, "An" represents grace or nourishment, and "Ma" represents the divine mother. It is a name that symbolizes the love and care of a mother towards her child. Naming a child Anma is considered as an expression of deep maternal love and the desire to nourish and nurture that child. It is also believed to bestow the blessings of the goddess Annapurna upon the child, ensuring her good health and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: Anma is a name that has deep spiritual significance in Hindu culture. It is derived from the words ‘anu’ meaning near and ‘ma’ meaning mother. The Hindu goddess Annapurna is associated with this name. She is the goddess of food and nourishment and is believed to provide sustenance and fulfill all the desires of her devotees. Naming a child Anma signifies the child's spiritual connection to Annapurna and her divine energies. It also represents the child's potential to awaken the divine mother within and to serve others by nourishing and loving them. The name Anma is thus a powerful reminder of the importance of love, compassion, and nourishment in our lives.

This name is a reminder of the divine bond between a mother and her child, fostering feelings of warmth, comfort, and security.
